note: Parameters of the synthetic weather generator that stands in for real ERA5/PECD weather-years until part (b). Cross-zone correlation of daily wind regimes (Western Denmark and Germany move together, Norway follows at a distance, Spain is largely independent), daily cloudiness correlation, a mild tendency for calm days to be sunny, and the persistence (AR(1) coefficients) of wind regimes, cloudiness and hydro inflow. All invented; the real pipeline replaces the generator entirely, so these numbers never ship.
